messages:
eli: Quick heads-up 1:30 UTC change window for a small model catalog enable. Target model: quant-v3 (memory-optimized). Plan: tiny canary 0.5% -> 3% -> 15% -> 100% with 15m soak between ramps. Fallback order must be explicit and immutable for the run: quant-v3,quant-v2,base-fp16.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary: 21:32 UTC; id=cb-3321; executor=deploy-bot. Routing: canary-only.

mira: Observability hooks: p95 delta +20ms abort, error-rate abort at >=0.7% over 10m, KV-cache miss delta >8% pause ramp. Im provisioning a quick per-model tail-sampling trace too.

sam: Rollback policy: immediate rollback for (a) sustained p95 +35ms for 5m, (b) error-rate >=1% for 3m, (c) quality regression >4% on the eval suite. Im onpager for rollback decisions.

anika: Im updating release notes and adding a short customer-facing blurb for customers in the "priority" tag. Well proactively pin any tenants with custom SLAs for 48h.

eli: Operational command to run at start: `catalog apply --model quant-v3 --canary 0.5 --fallback "quant-v3,quant-v2,base-fp16" --annotate cb-3321`. Mira please validate fallbacks on the sequencer before I flip.

mira: Will validate. Sequencer accepts explicit fallback order; also toggling memory-throttle for quant-v3 to avoid OOM storms.

deploy-bot: ack: fallback order applied for cb-3321. Memory throttle set: 0.85.

eli: Observability watchlist: p50/p95/p99, token/second, kv-cache-hit, model-memory-usage, soft-fail rate. If memory usage across GPUs increases >5% we halt.

mira: First 2k canary requests: p95 +2ms, errors 0.05%, KV-hit stable. Sampled traces show expected attention kernels.

sam: Running the 50-prompt eval set every 15m. First run shows no regression (delta 0.6%). Will post results here.

anika: Noted. Im also prepping statuspage blurb in case we need to post; keeping it templated.

eli: ramping to 3% now. ETA to full 15% if healthy ~45m.

mira: 21:51 check: p95 +11ms (within guard), KV-miss +1.2%, errors 0.06%. Eval delta 1.2% after 15m run.

sam: All good to me. Continue to 15% after the next soak unless folks flag.

eli: Reminder: enterprise & partner customers on the priority tag remain pinned to base-fp16 automatically; weve added a manual pin script: `catalog pin --account <acct> --model base-fp16 --duration 48h`. Use if you see any spikes.

mira: If we need a forced rollback: `deploy-bot rollback cb-3321 --reason "auto/threshold"`. If invoked, Sam will trigger comms and well attach the last 30m telemetry dump.

anika: Thanks all. Im posting the release note + internal runbook link to the #releases docs channel and pinging CS.

deploy-bot: canary started at 21:32:12 UTC 1% routing: cb-3321 -> quant-v3 0.5%.

mira: 21:37 check: p95 +3ms, errors 0.07%, sampled outputs look fine.

sam: Green. Proceed to 3%.

eli: ramped to 3% at 21:40 UTC. Monitoring closely. Will update at the 15m check-in.

mira: 21:55 check: p95 +13ms (OK), KV-hit stable, no quality regressions.

eli: Note for postmortem: experiment with slightly higher memory-trim on quant-v3 next time if we see memory jitter at 15% ramp.

sam: Copy. If anything changes flag with :rotating_light: here and we escalate.

anika: Thanks everyone. Im going to leave the CS note draft in the docs for review.
